drg.description: Simple Pneumonia and Pleurisy with MCC

timeline.text: Chest x-ray: right lower lobe opacity

notes.text:
HISTORY AND PHYSICAL. Patient seen and examined at bedside. 72-year-old male admitted for community-acquired pneumonia. Admission data:
Day 0: labs bilirubin 0.73, creatinine 0.97, hemoglobin 13.9, pao2 57, platelets 298, sodium 138, wbc 6.9; vitals dbp 68-72, heart_rate 71-76, map 88-91, o2_flow 0-5, resp_rate 26-31, sbp 124-130, spo2 88-94, temp 36.8-37.1
Day 0 orders/meds/results: Ceftriaxone 1 g IV; Chest x-ray: right lower lobe opacity; Oxygen via nasal cannula 5 L/min
Assessment and plan: Community-acquired pneumonia. Acute hypoxic respiratory failure.

PROGRESS NOTE, hospital day 1. Patient seen and examined at bedside. Data:
Day 1: labs creatinine 0.96, hemoglobin 13.9, platelets 301, sodium 138, wbc 6.1; vitals dbp 67-72, heart_rate 73-77, map 86-91, o2_flow 5, resp_rate 21-27, sbp 124-129, spo2 93-95, temp 36.9-37
Day 1 orders/meds/results: Ceftriaxone 1 g IV
Assessment and plan: Community-acquired pneumonia. Acute hypoxic respiratory failure. Continue current management.

DISCHARGE SUMMARY. 72-year-old male, length of stay 4 days. Hospital course: treated per the plan above with daily labs and vital signs; stable for discharge. Medications reconciled and return precautions reviewed. Discharge diagnoses: Community-acquired pneumonia. Acute hypoxic respiratory failure. Follow up with primary care in one week. Patient interviewed and examined; nursing notes reviewed.
